text: No operator odds page is fetched or scraped until that operator's terms of use have been read and recorded.
Only licensed or terms-permitted price data may populate a market column.
A price without a capture timestamp and a content hash is not a price; it is excluded.
Opening and closing are separate rows, never one 'current' number.
A residual may never be published without the market value it was subtracted from.
No backtest performance figure may appear on the leaderboard, in any column, ever.
Leaderboard ranking uses benchmark-relative Brier skill with a game-cluster lower bound and a multiplicity adjustment; win rate and ROI are not ranking metrics.
Signal and staking are scored in separate columns and neither may be inferred from the other.
A live strategy returns to paper when any demotion trigger in demotion.csv fires.
